name: Verbal & Written Communication
description: Mastery of clear, empathetic, and professional communication across spoken conversations, formal emails, and patient interactions.
practical_assignment: Draft 3 professional emails (Requesting academic clarification from a lecturer, submitting a tailoring quote to a client, inquiring about volunteering).
rubric_level_5: Communicates with effortless poise, precision, active listening, and adapts tone seamlessly to lecturers, patients, and clients.
rubric_level_1: Struggles with sentence clarity, avoids eye contact, lacks formal email structure.

name: Public Speaking & Presentation Delivery
description: Structuring persuasive speeches, overcoming stage fright, using slides effectively, and delivering compelling spoken presentations.
practical_assignment: Deliver a 10-15 minute presentation on 'How the Human Cardiovascular System Maintains Homeostasis' to family or peers.
rubric_level_5: Delivers engaging, well-structured 15-minute presentations with clear voice projection, storytelling, and confident Q&A handling.
rubric_level_1: Experiences paralyzing anxiety, reads verbatim from notes without engaging the audience.

name: Critical Thinking & Evidence Evaluation
description: Evaluating claims using the 7-question critical framework, distinguishing correlation from causation, and detecting cognitive biases.
practical_assignment: Critique two viral Nigerian social media health claims using peer-reviewed medical sources.
rubric_level_5: Systematically questions claims, inspects evidence sources, identifies hidden assumptions, and forms objective conclusions.
rubric_level_1: Accepts unverified claims or forwarded messages without questioning validity.

name: Structured Problem Solving & Decision Making
description: Root-cause analysis (5 Whys), risk evaluation, prioritization matrices, and systematic troubleshooting under pressure.
practical_assignment: Solve a real-world tailoring bottleneck (fabric shrinkage or delayed delivery) using a root-cause diagram and contingency plan.
rubric_level_5: Deconstructs complex challenges into root causes, generates multiple evaluated alternatives, and executes robust solutions.
rubric_level_1: Reacts emotionally to problems, treats superficial symptoms rather than root causes.

name: Emotional Intelligence & Self-Regulation
description: Recognizing emotional triggers, managing stress, demonstrating profound empathy, and handling constructive criticism gracefully.
practical_assignment: Maintain a daily 15-minute reflection journal documenting emotional triggers, stressors, and regulation strategies.
rubric_level_5: Demonstrates high self-awareness, stays calm under pressure, handles criticism with gratitude, and shows genuine empathy.
rubric_level_1: Becomes easily defensive, struggles with emotional volatility, lacks empathy for others' viewpoints.

name: Confidence & Healthy Self-Awareness
description: Grounding self-worth in competence and character, understanding personal strengths/weaknesses, and maintaining a growth mindset.
practical_assignment: Conduct a personal SWOT analysis (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats) for university preparation.
rubric_level_5: Exudes quiet competence and self-assurance without arrogance; embraces mistakes as learning opportunities.
rubric_level_1: Crippled by self-doubt and impostor syndrome, avoids challenging tasks due to fear of failure.

name: Ethical Leadership & Accountability
description: Servant leadership, taking full ownership of outcomes, delegating responsibility, and inspiring peers toward collective goals.
practical_assignment: Coordinate a community service activity or family project from planning to execution.
rubric_level_5: Takes total accountability for team success and failure, motivates others, and leads with integrity.
rubric_level_1: Passes blame to others, shies away from responsibility, struggles to motivate peers.

name: Teamwork & Interprofessional Collaboration
description: Working harmoniously with diverse personalities, resolving team disagreements, and prioritizing team outcomes.
practical_assignment: Participate in a collaborative volunteer project or study group, facilitating consensus on divided opinions.
rubric_level_5: Thrives in diverse teams, mediates conflicts constructively, and elevates teammates' contributions.
rubric_level_1: Prefers solitary work to avoid confrontation, struggles to compromise or listen to opposing ideas.

name: Time Management & Habit Formation
description: Time blocking, Pomodoro deep work, Eisenhower matrix prioritization, and eliminating procrastination.
practical_assignment: Maintain a disciplined weekly timetable balancing 8 hours of tailoring, 90 mins of academic study, and 30 mins of reading.
rubric_level_5: Consistently adheres to time blocks, meets deadlines ahead of schedule, and maintains balanced life routines.
rubric_level_1: Chronically misses deadlines, suffers from severe procrastination, has no structured daily routine.

name: Financial Discipline & Budgeting
description: Prudent budgeting, differentiating needs from wants, disciplined savings, and acute awareness of scams and gambling risks.
practical_assignment: Create a monthly budget tracking personal income, expenses, emergency fund savings, and tailoring revenues.
rubric_level_5: Maintains strict budgeting records, consistently saves, understands compound growth, and spots financial scams instantly.
rubric_level_1: Spends impulsively without tracking expenses, has zero savings, susceptible to get-rich-quick claims.

name: Customer Service & Service Recovery
description: Building long-term customer trust, active listening, managing dissatisfied clients, and ensuring superior service delivery.
practical_assignment: Audit customer interaction in the tailoring shop; document 3 instances of proactive customer delight.
rubric_level_5: Anticipates client needs, resolves grievances with high warmth and professionalism, turning complaints into loyalty.
rubric_level_1: Dismissive of customer concerns, argues with clients, fails to communicate delays.

name: Principled Negotiation
description: Win-win negotiation, establishing BATNA, articulating value without desperation, and maintaining ethical boundaries.
practical_assignment: Negotiate fair fabric wholesale pricing and customer tailoring charges based on calculated labor hours.
rubric_level_5: Negotiates confidently from a position of mutual value, achieves win-win outcomes, and maintains cordial relations.
rubric_level_1: Underprices skills out of fear of losing clients or adopts an aggressive, confrontational stance.

name: Professionalism & Workplace Etiquette
description: Uncompromising punctuality, reliability, confidentiality, boundary setting, and professional attire/demeanor.
practical_assignment: Arrive 10 minutes early to all commitments for 30 consecutive days; document observations.
rubric_level_5: Exemplifies punctuality, discretion, integrity, and flawless workplace etiquette at all times.
rubric_level_1: Frequently late, unreliable with commitments, blurs personal and professional boundaries.

name: Resilience & Adaptability
description: Bouncing back from setbacks, academic hurdles, and unforeseen disruptions with psychological flexibility and optimism.
practical_assignment: Write a reflective essay detailing a significant past failure or disappointment and 3 actionable lessons extracted.
rubric_level_5: Remains calm and focused during crises, views setbacks as diagnostic data, and pivots constructively.
rubric_level_1: Gives up at the first sign of difficulty, falls into despair over negative feedback.

name: Self-Advocacy & Seeking Help
description: Asking insightful questions, articulating needs respectfully, setting boundaries, and seeking mentorship proactively.
practical_assignment: Schedule and conduct a 15-minute informational interview with a senior nurse, doctor, or university student.
rubric_level_5: Advocates for needs clearly and respectfully, proactively seeks mentorship, and asks thoughtful questions.
rubric_level_1: Suffers in silence when confused, fears asking questions, avoids reaching out to mentors.
